_meta.server: ogamex.eu/Aeternum, GALAXYZ 1.8.git (2Moons fork), English UI, saved 2026-10-30

srcTags.REAL <page>.html: copied from the real saved page eu/pages/<page>.html
srcTags.UPSTREAM <file>:<line>: upstream 2Moons default (the fork keeps vars in the DB; admins may have changed it)
srcTags.DERIVED: computed from REAL values by an upstream rule

formulas.buildingResearchPrice: price(level L) = cost * factor^(L-1), per resource, floored for display (UPSTREAM class.BuildFunctions.php:65-96); cost here = level-1 price
formulas.buildTime: hours = (metal+crystal) / (game_speed * (1 + robot14)) * 0.5^nanite15 * (1 + BuildTime bonus); ships use shipyard21 (UPSTREAM class.BuildFunctions.php:152-156)
formulas.researchTime: hours = (metal+crystal) / (1000 * (1 + lab31 incl. IRN)) / (game_speed/2500) * (1 - factor_university/100)^university6 * (1 + ResearchTime bonus) (UPSTREAM :170)
formulas.note: game_speed and factor_university are server config, not visible on any saved page; fleetStep1 data.gamespeed=7 is the FLEET speed only. Prefer times shown by the details AJAX.

notes: Every element on a list page is shown, also those whose requirements are unmet (div.icon[data-status=off]); upstream hid them.
220 Dark Matter Collector: REAL CostInfo is 100x cheaper than upstream (60000/70000/30000 vs 6M/7M/3M).
407-409, 411, 502, 503: not in CostInfo (fleetDealer cannot scrap them) -> cost is UPSTREAM only.
41-43 (moon) never appear on a saved list page (all saved pages are planets).
Ship attack/shield/capacity/rapidfire: no real page shows them; UPSTREAM only.
